items.prompt: $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle DEF$, $AB=6$, $DE=15$. Find the scale factor.
Explain the difference between congruent and similar figures.
items.answer: Congruent figures have the same shape and the same size (scale factor $1$); similar figures have the same shape but may differ in size (any positive scale factor).

steps: Congruent = same size; similar = same shape, any size.
